items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: My brother is two years and four months younger than I and he has become a very successful actor.

ctx.x: That's nice. Well, now you and Arnie, you were talented -- you were personalities, both of you, I suppose he was too, as a young -- as he grew up. Is he older or younger?
My brother is two years and four months younger than I and he has become a very successful actor.
He has. You told me he is in the Barney Miller Show now.
